name: Visselhövede (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Visselhövede (a black cross with a yellow ring bearing a head on white).
history: Municipal flag of Visselhövede; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Visselhövede arms — cross with ring and head on white
